visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man wearing a blue fantasy-style tunic and brown boots is sitting on a bright green artificial grass floor in a studio set decorated with 2D cutouts of trees and bushes. He looks around in confusion with a wide-eyed expression. (2) A blonde woman dressed in a blue and white cosplay outfit resembling a mage or healer appears. She holds an open leather-bound book and gestures toward the man while speaking with an animated facial expression. (3) The man holds out his hand, showing small red scratches. The woman in the blue dress places her gloved hand over his wrist, and glowing yellow particles appear as a visual effect for healing. (4) The man stands up and tries to run forward but hits an invisible barrier, which causes a visual effect of glass cracking across the screen. A woman with long purple hair and a large magical staff appears in a dramatic pose. (5) The man, the blonde woman, and the purple-haired woman walk in a line toward the right of the screen. A person wearing a green goblin mask and bodysuit jumps out to challenge them. (6) A third woman in a red and white kimono-style outfit with white fur and horns on her head appears. She carries a long katana. The man draws a large golden sword. (7) A montage shows the characters fighting the green goblins in a side-scrolling fashion. The characters use exaggerated combat movements, accompanied by visual effects like light streaks and impact flashes. (8) One goblin attempts to stop the fighting by blowing a kiss and creating a pink heart effect around its head, making the man look confused. (9) The screen transitions to a black background with a stylized game logo featuring white text and gold accents. (10) The man is now in a modern indoor bedroom with a bed and window blinds. The woman in the red kimono outfit stands next to him, making a cat-like hand gesture near her face.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 male main creator, 3 female lead characters, and 3 actors in goblin costumes.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: The main male character wears a blue fantasy tunic with brown boots. The three female characters are in high-quality RPG cosplay: one in a blue/white dress, one with purple hair and a staff, and one in a red/white kimono with horns.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The primary scene is a studio set designed to look like a forest with a green floor, painted forest background, and cardboard-like cutouts of bushes. The final scene is a modern, realistic indoor bedroom with a bed and wooden blinds.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a suspenseful, orchestral swell and the male protagonist yelling in confusion with high vocal arousal. (2) A sharp transition lead to light, bouncy RPG-style synthesizer background music as a female voice explains the setting with a friendly, professional tone. (3) A magical 'shimmer' SFX plays during the healing scene, followed by a loud, percussive glass-breaking sound effect when the man hits the invisible barrier. (4) The BGM shifts to a more energetic, heroic theme with driving drums. Multiple 'whoosh' sounds accompany fast camera pans and character transitions. (5) Combat sounds dominate the middle section, including metallic sword clashing SFXs, rhythmic impact thuds, and exaggerated vocal grunts from the 'goblins.' (6) A comedic 'ding' or whistle SFX occurs when the goblin shows a heart, followed by a brief comedic pause in the music. (7) The music reaches a peak with a dramatic orchestral jingle for the game logo reveal. (8) The final scene features ambient indoor quietness, followed by a distinct human vocal 'meow' sound effect to close the video.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a live-action promotional advertisement for a mobile game called '遺忘之劍' (Forgotten Sword). It uses a comedic 'isekai' (alternate world) narrative where a real person is transported into a side-scrolling RPG world. The intent is to showcase the game's characters, combat style, and quirky humor to encourage app downloads.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video features actors in character costumes, clear on-screen titles of the game, and a final call-to-action screen with 'Google Play' and 'App Store' buttons.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video utilizes popular internet tropes like 'looking at backflipping cats' to add a layer of social-native humor to the game promotion.
